en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with rolling hills, a winding road lined with trees, several scattered houses, and a large building in the foreground identified as 'Streller's Gasthof' (an inn or guesthouse). The scene is tranquil with open fields, some forest in the background, and a few people visible near the buildings. The text on the postcard is in German.
